```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "The cascode gate was taken from a diode replica stacked on M1, so the drain of M1 sat near 0.73 V and M2 could not stay saturated. Biasing the cascode gate from a low-gm/Id replica of M2 (Vgs ~0.9 V) puts x near 0.3 V. The sink replica is now a copy of that device, which removes the stacked bias path."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":       (11e-6, 8e-6, 16e-6),   # driver branch current
    "L1":      (2.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # driver length
    "L2":      (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),        # cascode length
    "L3":      (2.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS load length (sets ro3 -> Rout ~4 MOhm)
    "gmid1":   (9.0, 7.5, 11.0),       # driver gm/Id (sets Vgs ~0.75 V to match vin)
    "gmid2":   (14.0, 11.0, 16.0),     # cascode gm/Id (low Vdsat, low stack cost)
    "gmid_r":  (8.0, 6.0, 10.0),       # cascode bias replica gm/Id (sets vbn ~0.9 V)
    "gmid_p":  (7.0, 5.0, 10.0),       # PMOS load gm/Id (high intrinsic gain)
    "kload":   (1.0, 0.9, 1.1),        # PMOS load / driver current ratio (sets vout DC)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    I = p["I"]
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    CL = spec["cl"]

    # Driver M1
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=0.5)

    # Cascode bias: diode replica mr2 on ibias sets vbn = ibias node voltage
    mr2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_r"], p["L2"], Iref, vds=0.9, vsb=0.0)
    vbn = mr2.vgs

    # Cascode M2 sized with body effect; its source (x) is set by vbn - Vgs2
    x = 0.3
    for _ in range(3):
        m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=x)
        x = vbn - m2.vgs

    # PMOS current-source load and its diode reference (Iref)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], p["kload"] * I, vds=0.9)
    mbp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], Iref, vds=0.9)
    vbp_gate = VDD - mbp.vgs

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)             # CS driver
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m2)          # NMOS cascode, gate = vbn
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)          # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("Mr2", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr2)     # diode replica -> vbn
    n.dev("Mn", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr2)        # copy of mr2: sinks Iref into vbp
    n.dev("Mbp", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mbp)         # PMOS diode sourcing Iref into vbp

    # First-order predictions
    vmin = x + m2.vdsat
    vmax = VDD - m3.vdsat
    vdc = 0.5 * (vmin + vmax)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vdc - vmin, vmax - vdc)

    Rcas = (m2.gm / m2.gds) / m1.gds
    Rout = 1.0 / (m3.gds + 1.0 / Rcas)
    A = m1.gm * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * CL)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * CL)
    power = VDD * (p["kload"] * I + 2 * Iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vdc,
        "swing": swing,
        "m1_headroom": x - m1.vdsat,
        "mn_headroom": vbp_gate - mr2.vdsat,
    }
```
